definitions.short: properly, to pour out (transitive or intransitive); by implication, to melt or cast as metal ; by extension, to place firmly , to stiffen or grow hard
definitions.usage: cast, cleave fast, be (as) firm, grow, be hard, lay out, molten, overflow, pour (out), run out, set down, stedfast.
